params.1273: Before you go off to drug the dragon, check your surroundings. The minimap in the top-right of the screen gives a general picture; for more detail, open the world map by clicking on the globe icon.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: Check the minimap in the top-right corner of the screen to see a plan of the cellar.
params.1275: For a more complete picture of the area, click on the globe button next to the minimap.
params.1276: The world map will show you many other places once you are free of this cellar.
